verdict.rationale: Cloudflare provides a scaffolding CLI (`npm create cloudflare@latest`) that offers starters for multiple frameworks (React, Vue, Svelte, Next, Astro) and even MCP server templates, effectively acting as quick-start templates for common use cases. However, the evidence shows no dedicated 'one-click deploy' gallery or marketplace like some competitors, so the experience is CLI/starter-based rather than a true one-click template button.
